properties.name: A requirement sent to another design (a parent's to its part, or a customer's to a supplier) arrives there proposed, with its origin, and binds only on the receiving owner's word
properties.source: Anthony, 2026-10-07: rulings on dec:idea-intent-crosses-designs ("Once accepted") and dec:idea-gap-flows-to-the-dependency ("Write-only-at-proposed"), for slice 3 of the hub work
properties.statement: When one design sends a requirement to another (a parent allocating to its part, or a customer levying one on a supplier), the receiving design shall hold it as its own Requirement at `proposed`. It shall carry its origin: the sending design, the sender's requirement id where there is one, and the version it was taken from. It shall be attributed to whoever sent it. Only the receiving design's owner shall move it off `proposed`. The receiving design shall report the requirements waiting on its owner's word, and an origin that has moved since the requirement was received. A parent shall see whether each requirement it allocated was accepted, dropped or is still waiting.
